about: Federal Reserve Banks' closed weekdays before K.8's years: the federal holidays (5 U.S.C. 6103) as the Reserve Banks observe them. A Saturday holiday closes no weekday (the Banks open the Friday before; only the Board closes); a Sunday holiday closes the Monday after. 2003-2009 were checked against the NY Fed's yearly holiday circulars, and 2026-2030 against K.8 (tests). 1986-2002 come from the statute alone. No one-off closures: the Banks and Fedwire stayed open on 9/11, through Hurricane Sandy and on the national days of mourning (docs/backfill.md).

holidays.name: Birthday of Martin Luther King, Jr.

notes.Juneteenth: Federal holiday from June 17, 2021. June 19, 2021 was a Saturday, so under the Saturday rule no weekday closed; the Board's press release confirms Federal Reserve Financial Services operated normally on Friday, June 18, 2021.
